newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Amsterdam bourse probes trade in Ceteco.
newsitem.headline: Amsterdam bourse probes trade in Ceteco.

text.p: The Amsterdam bourse said on Tuesday it was looking into unusually heavy trading in trader and retailer Ceteco after its shares rose sharply prior to the release of first-half results on Monday, August 26.
"It has the attention of the Amsterdam Stock Exchange trade supervisor," stock exchange spokesman Herman de Ranitz said.
Ceteco reported 1996 first-half net profits rose 11 percent to 5.8 million guilders after the close of bourse trading on Monday.
Turnover in Ceteco shares on Monday was more than double the usual daily average of 15,000 shares, and the stock put on 4.20 guilders to close the day at 94.70.
But traders in the stock said it was not unusual for share turnover and prices to pick up significantly ahead of the publication of a company's results.
"There is no indication of insider trading," a trader said. "The numbers were actually rather below expectations, and that's why the shares have gone down."
The exchange's trade supervisor reports to a watchdog which decides about possible investigations into insider trading.
The shares were trading at 92.90 in late Tuesday trade, down 1.80 guilders from Monday's pre-results close.
